content.title: CytoDyn to present poster at AACR conference on mTNBC
content.summary: CytoDyn (CYDY) will present a poster and an oral presentation at the AACR Special Conference in Cancer Research: Mechanisms of Cancer Immunity and Cancer-related Autoimmunity, taking place September 24, to September 27, 2025, in Montreal, Canada. Key Findings: CCR5 inhibition combined with ICI therapy increased overall survival in patients with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer, mTNBC, with 18% of heavily pretreated mTNBC patients alive after a median of ~60 months.
